title: Your deal path
lead: From your first request to the keys. Your broker records each step when it happens.
preview: The later steps are the usual ones for this kind of deal. Your broker confirms them once the terms are agreed.

brokerage_agreement.label: Brokerage contract
brokerage_agreement.about: The client and the agency sign a written contract for the agency's service and its fee.

request_received.label: Request received
request_received.about: The agency receives the request and names a broker to look after it.

needs_agreed.label: Needs agreed
needs_agreed.about: The broker writes down what the client is looking for and the client confirms it.

homes_shortlisted.label: Homes shortlisted
homes_shortlisted.about: The client picks the homes worth a closer look from the broker's suggestions.

viewings.label: Viewings
viewings.about: The broker arranges visits to the chosen homes and goes with the client.

terms_agreed.label: Terms agreed
terms_agreed.about: Both sides accept the same price and conditions on the proposal.

identity_checks.label: Identity checks
identity_checks.about: The agency checks the identity documents of each person taking part.

deposit_preliminary_contract.label: Deposit and preliminary contract
deposit_preliminary_contract.about: The buyer and the seller sign a preliminary contract and the buyer pays the agreed deposit.

property_checks.label: Property checks
property_checks.about: The agency gathers the documents on the property's ownership and debts so they can be reviewed before the deed.

funds_ready.label: Funds ready
funds_ready.about: The buyer arranges the money for the purchase, from savings or a bank loan.

notary_deed.label: Notary deed
notary_deed.about: A notary prepares the deed and reads it with the buyer and the seller before they sign.

registration.label: Registration
registration.about: The signed deed is entered in the property register in the buyer's name.

keys_handed_over.label: Keys handed over
keys_handed_over.about: The owner hands over the keys on the agreed day.

lease_signed.label: Lease signed
lease_signed.about: The tenant and the landlord sign the lease on the agreed terms.

deposit_first_rent.label: Deposit and first rent
deposit_first_rent.about: The tenant pays the deposit and the first rent, and both sides confirm the money arrived.

tax_number.label: Greek tax number
tax_number.about: The buyer gets a Greek tax number (AFM), which the purchase documents refer to.

lawyer_property_checks.label: Lawyer's property checks
lawyer_property_checks.about: The buyer's lawyer looks into who owns the property and whether any debts are attached to it.

contract_signed.label: Contract signed
contract_signed.about: The buyer and the seller sign the contract on the agreed terms.

completed.title: Deal completed
completed.lead: Every step on this path is done and your broker confirmed the completion.
completed.boundary: This page shows what the people involved did and when. It is not a legal certificate.
